title: Epidemiological Study on Community Acquired Pneumonia
official: Epidemiological Study on Community Acquired Pneumonia
summary: The main objective of this study is to investigate prevalence and risk factors for community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) and its interaction with comorbidities in an unselected group of adult patients receiving outpatient and inpatient care. In addition, information on HIV as a risk factor for CAP and on CAP in immunocompromised patients is collected.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age ≥ 18
* infiltrate on chest X-ray
* further Inclusion criteria (at least one must apply): cough or purulent sputum or pathologic lung auscultation (crackles) or fever

Exclusion Criteria:

* Hospitalization lasting longer than 48 hours prior to the diagnosis of the current pneumonia
* Newly diagnosed, active pulmonary tuberculosis within the last 2 months
